complete_examples.text: Consequently, there is a pressing need for further investigation into the dynamic performance of vehicle-track interaction within AFZs, particularly for slab-based bal lastless track designs.

Moreover, the laying angle of the ballastless track is also a sig nificant factor that degrades the performance of the vehicle-track interaction system subjected to fault dislo cation, an aspect overlooked in previous research related to railway foundation deformation.
